biomarkers.name: Same as FOLLICULAR_GRADE_1_2
biomarkers.clinical_use: See FOLLICULAR_GRADE_1_2; grade 3A commonly shares the canonical FL immunophenotype and genetics, including frequent t(14;18)(q32;q21)/IGH::BCL2 and BCL2 expression, with recurrent CREBBP, KMT2D, EZH2, TNFRSF14, EP300 and STAT6 alterations; however, t(14;18) and BCL2 expression are less consistently present than in grades 1-2.

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Follicular architecture with >15 centroblasts/HPF but with residual centrocytes

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Overlap between indolent (grade 1-2) and aggressive (grade 3B/DLBCL) biology

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Germinal centre B cells with increased centroblast component
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Follicular architecture preserved with residual centrocytes despite >15 centroblasts/HPF; retains germinal centre programme
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Intermediate position between low-grade FL and grade 3B/DLBCL on differentiation/proliferation spectrum
